selection_method: Merge three immutable RSS collection batches.
Normalize feed-section names to the underlying publisher.
Retain publishers in a reviewed source allowlist.
Rank observable company-event terms above lifestyle, sports, personal-finance and podcast items.
Limit each publisher to at most 15 records and select 200 records deterministically.
known_limitations: This is an unlabelled candidate set, not the final evaluation gold set.
Google News RSS entries link through Google News and may contain only headline-level summaries.
Exact URL duplicates were removed; semantic same-event clustering is not performed.
Repeated coverage by different publishers remains intentionally available for later evaluation design.
PRIMARY_TICKER and EVENT_TYPE must be assigned only during the planned human annotation stage.
